entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was travelling to the snow-covere..."
entries.dialogueText: I was travelling to the snow-covered city of Narbel in the Nargis region for the rural development forum organized by the Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Education.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“We will be arriving at Hotel West..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will be arriving at Hotel West in a few minutes, sir.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Can't say it's been a comfortable..."
entries.dialogueText: “Can't say it's been a comfortable ride, Serge.”
entries.menuText: “Can't say it's been a comfortable ride, Serge.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you for letting me know.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for letting me know.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you for letting me know.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Any time. It is my duty.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Any time. It is my duty.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“I am sorry sir. The roads here are..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am sorry sir. The roads here aren't the best.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a moment, Serge started to sm..."
entries.dialogueText: After a moment, Serge started to smile under his moustache.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“How is life, Serge?”"
entries.dialogueText: “How is life, Serge?”
entries.menuText: “How is life, Serge?”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Sir, I just want to say... It has..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sir, I just want to say... It has been great these last two months.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“As you know, my wife Suzan recentl..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you know, my wife Suzan recently gave birth to our son. And now my daughter just started at a very good high school in Holsord."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Congratulations.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Congratulations.”
entries.menuText: “Congratulations.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Get ready, Serge. Because life is..."
entries.dialogueText: “Get ready, Serge. Because life is about to become a lot busier.”
entries.menuText: “Get ready, Serge. Because life is about to become a lot busier.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“The doctors said he is very health..."
entries.dialogueText: “The doctors said he is very healthy and thankfully so is my wife.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“But I shouldn't have made my insec..."
entries.dialogueText: “But I shouldn't have made my insecurity get to me. Erica outsmarts me all the time. I'm very proud to have a daughter like her.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“How are your children, sir, if I m..."
entries.dialogueText: “How are your children, sir, if I may ask?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Tell me more about Suzan. What kin..."
entries.dialogueText: “Tell me more about Suzan. What kind of a person is she?”
entries.menuText: “Tell me more about Suzan. What kind of a person is she?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Why did you want another child?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Why did you want another child?”
entries.menuText: “Why did you want another child?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Deana is as lively as ever, but Fr..."
entries.dialogueText: “Deana is as lively as ever, but Franc seems to be a little distant.”
entries.menuText: “Deana is as lively as ever, but Franc seems to be a little distant.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They are both doing just fine. Goi..."
entries.dialogueText: “They are both doing just fine. Going through different phases in life.”
entries.menuText: “They are both doing just fine. Going through different phases in life.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“So that means she must have gotten..."
entries.dialogueText: “So that means she must have gotten the smarts from her mother.”
entries.menuText: “So that means she must have gotten the smarts from her mother.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I too hope that Deana will grow to..."
entries.dialogueText: “I too hope that Deana will grow to be like her mother someday.”
entries.menuText: “I also hope that Deana will grow to be like her mother someday.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Have I told you, sir? We named my..."
entries.dialogueText: “Have I told you, sir? We named my son Georg.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Oh, I know, sir. It already is ver..."
entries.dialogueText: “Oh, I know, sir. It already is very busy. My daughter is a handful.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“I appreciate it, sir. Truly. I was..."
entries.dialogueText: “I appreciate it, sir. Truly. I was worried that I wouldn't be able to afford a good private school if she scored less in the entrance exams.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“I come from a big family. I'm one..."
entries.dialogueText: “I come from a big family. I'm one of five siblings so having company is a constant in my life.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“She's beautiful, of course. But wh..."
entries.dialogueText: “She's beautiful, of course. But what I really admire is her selflessness.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“I can understand that completely,..."
entries.dialogueText: “I can understand that completely, sir."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“That's very normal, sir. He is at..."
entries.dialogueText: “That's very normal, sir. He is at that age. All of us went through a rebellious phase.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The motorcade began approaching the..."
entries.dialogueText: The motorcade began approaching the hotel.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“I'm sure she will sir. After all s..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm sure she will sir. After all she is the daughter of a lion and a lioness.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“She must have!”"
entries.dialogueText: “She must have!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He let out a laugh."
entries.dialogueText: He let out a laugh.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“See you later, Serge.”"
entries.dialogueText: “See you later, Serge.”
entries.menuText: “See you later, Serge.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Have a good day, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Have a good day, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
Player
entries.title: Player: "“What's that smile for?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What's that smile for?”
entries.menuText: “What's that smile for?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That's good. I hope the hospital h..."
entries.dialogueText: “That's good. I hope the hospital had a good service.”
entries.menuText: “That's good. I hope the hospital had a good service.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Normally, we would have been treat..."
entries.dialogueText: “Normally, we would have been treated in one of the suburban hospitals.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“But thanks to the special coverage..."
entries.dialogueText: “But thanks to the special coverage of the presidential staff, we were transferred to Emerald State Hospital.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Glad that I could help.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Glad that I could help.”
entries.menuText: “Glad that I could help.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We need to increase the quality of..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need to increase the quality of the services for all.”
entries.menuText: “We need to increase the quality of the services for all.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Emerald State is a great hospital...."
entries.dialogueText: “Emerald State is a great hospital.”
entries.menuText: “Emerald State is a great hospital.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“You could call it a little traditi..."
entries.dialogueText: “You could call it a little traditional but it just feels right.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sarna is a nice little city.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Sarna is a nice little city.”
entries.menuText: “Sarna is a nice little city.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Selflessness is a respectable trai..."
entries.dialogueText: “Selflessness is a respectable trait to have.”
entries.menuText: “Selflessness is a respectable trait to have.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Monica is persevering. It can be i..."
entries.dialogueText: “Monica is persevering. It can be inspiring at times to have a partner like that.”
entries.menuText: “Monica is persevering. It can be inspiring at times to have a partner like that.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are you fine?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Are you fine?”
entries.menuText: “Are you fine?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This is unacceptable. We need to i..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is unacceptable. We need to invest in infrastructure here.”
entries.menuText: “This is unacceptable. We need to invest in infrastructure here.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I do not value insecurity in my em..."
entries.dialogueText: “I do not value insecurity in my employees, Serge.”
entries.menuText: “I do not value insecurity in my employees, Serge.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Yes, sir. I will be more careful f..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, sir. I will be more careful from now on.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“She is an inspiration for almost a..."
entries.dialogueText: “She is an inspiration for almost all women in the country.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge sighed."
entries.dialogueText: Serge sighed.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Enough talking, Serge. Focus on th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Enough talking, Serge. Focus on the road.”
entries.menuText: “Enough talking, Serge. Focus on the road.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“The bazaar there is quite unique a..."
entries.dialogueText: “The bazaar there is quite unique and it is a good city. Nothing compares to Holsord of course.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“It should be mutual, that is what..."
entries.dialogueText: “It should be mutual, that is what matters most.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“It's only fitting. A lioness for a..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's only fitting. A lioness for a lion.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“The equipment and the staff were e..."
entries.dialogueText: “The equipment and the staff were exceptional.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“There are far more unfortunate peo..."
entries.dialogueText: “There are far more unfortunate people in this country. But thanks.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“That sounds like a tough issue to..."
entries.dialogueText: “That sounds like a tough issue to solve.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“I'm sorry. I will drive more caref..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm sorry. I will drive more carefully, sir.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“I agree sir. We still need to driv..."
entries.dialogueText: “I agree sir. We still need to drive back tomorrow unless you use one of those new helicopters.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Yes sir. I hope the car is fine to..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes sir. I hope the car is fine too.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The scenery so far, however, was a..."
entries.dialogueText: The scenery so far, however, was a reflection of Narbel's neglect. The main roads to the city were not maintained well. There were many bumps and empty discolored spots in the asphalt.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The scenery so far, however, was a..."
entries.dialogueText: The scenery so far, however, was a reflection of Narbel's neglect. The main roads to the city were not maintained well. There were many bumps and empty discolored spots in the asphalt.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Serge nodded.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I expect so much from them. They w..."
entries.dialogueText: “I expect so much from them. They will make me proud.”
entries.menuText: “I expect so much from them. They will make me proud.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“It must not be easy to be the chil..."
entries.dialogueText: “It must not be easy to be the children of a high-profile person like you.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“My daughter looks up to the First..."
entries.dialogueText: “My daughter looks up to the First Lady for inspiration and it's not just limited to my daughter, sir.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“It must be sir. We sometimes forge..."
entries.dialogueText: “It must be sir. We sometimes forget the important people in life between all the responsibility and rush.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“You know... Those we care for...”"
entries.dialogueText: “You know... Those we care for...”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“I had some troubles communicating..."
entries.dialogueText: “I had some troubles communicating with Erica as she grew up, but we found a common ground by going to plays.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“My children can talk to me if they..."
entries.dialogueText: “My children can talk to me if they want. It is up to them.”
entries.menuText: “My children can talk to me if they want. It is up to them.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Communication is the key.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Communication is the key.”
entries.menuText: “Communication is the key.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“...I was unlucky. I never had a co..."
entries.dialogueText: “...I was unlucky. I never had a connection with my father. He was absent from our life, and I just can't have the same situation with my children...”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Family is the cornerstone of life...."
entries.dialogueText: “Family is the cornerstone of life. We shouldn't forget that and it seems we do.”
entries.menuText: “Family is the cornerstone of life.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Traditional or not if it is what y..."
entries.dialogueText: “Traditional or not if it is what you want, that is all that matters.”
entries.menuText: “Traditional or not if it is what you want, that is all that matters.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He glanced towards the back."
entries.dialogueText: He glanced towards the back.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I was never a family person.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I was never a family person.”
entries.menuText: “I was never a family person.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Yes and it depends on what type of..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes and it depends on what type of environment it is. If its hostile...”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“We keep forgetting what we want an..."
entries.dialogueText: “We keep forgetting what we want and lose ourselves in the process.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“You have a good family.”"
entries.dialogueText: “You have a good family.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“She has a good heart. Her family c..."
entries.dialogueText: “She has a good heart. Her family comes from Sarna, so they are a little more traditional.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The mountainous city was infamously..."
entries.dialogueText: The mountainous city was infamously one of Sordland's poorest. It had a gritty edge, and its people were hardy and wary.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Even after the discovery of gas and..."
entries.dialogueText: Even after the discovery of gas and oil in the area, years of neglect by the central government were apparent on the buildings and the general infrastructure. The natural resources were now under the control of Gasom, which elevated the corporation to a place of power.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My task in this forum was mainly sy..."
entries.dialogueText: My task in this forum was mainly symbolic. Fake smiles and handshakes with oil barons, meeting with local politicians, but most importantly of all, making sure that Narbel did not feel like it was forgotten by the government.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As if my discomfort from the bumpy..."
entries.dialogueText: As if my discomfort from the bumpy ride was apparent to him, Serge rolled down the partition window.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good. Whatever gets us out of here..."
entries.dialogueText: “Good. Whatever gets us out of here quickly.”
entries.menuText: “Good. Whatever gets us out of here quickly.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I let out a deep sigh."
entries.dialogueText: I let out a deep sigh.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I pretended not to notice and looke..."
entries.dialogueText: I pretended not to notice and looked out the window.
entries.menuText: Pretend not to notice.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Thankfully, my work times allow me..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thankfully, my work times allow me to spend some time with my family, except for these distant trips. I'm very lucky to have this job.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge continued after a moment of s..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge continued after a moment of silence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Navigating and swerving to avoid th..."
entries.dialogueText: Navigating and swerving to avoid the inconveniences, our motorcade finally started nearing the city.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They are fine, but that's not your..."
entries.dialogueText: “They are fine, but that's not your business Serge.”
entries.menuText: “They are fine, but that's not your business Serge.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“No sir. You are right, sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No sir. You are right, sir.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked visibly irked by my comme..."
entries.dialogueText: He looked visibly irked by my comment and nodded.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I expect you to do your job. Not a..."
entries.dialogueText: “I expect you to do your job. Not ask questions about my private life.”
entries.menuText: “I expect you to do your job. Not ask questions about my private life.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's okay.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's okay.”
entries.menuText: “It's okay.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Understood, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Understood, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a long silence. After sev..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a long silence. After several minutes, Serge attempted to break silence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a long silence. After sev..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a long silence. After several minutes, Serge attempted to break silence.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Spare me your lectures, Serge.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Spare me your lectures, Serge.”
entries.menuText: “Spare me your lectures, Serge.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I agree.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I agree.”
entries.menuText: “I agree.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Yes sir. I am sorry sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes sir. I am sorry sir.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Spare me your lectures about paren..."
entries.dialogueText: “Spare me your lectures about parenthood, Serge.”
entries.menuText: “Spare me your lectures about parenthood, Serge.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My thoughts faded to my childhood...."
entries.dialogueText: My thoughts faded to my childhood. My father was also absent from home most of the time. I never connected with him, just like Serge.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Being a president meant that I had..."
entries.dialogueText: Being a president meant that I had to be away from home most of the time.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I wondered if Franc also thought of..."
entries.dialogueText: I wondered if Franc also thought of me as an absent father figure. Could that be the reason behind his attitude?

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“But at the same time, it must be h..."
entries.dialogueText: “But at the same time, it must be hard for the First Lady as well.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That is none of your business.”"
entries.dialogueText: “That is none of your business.”
entries.menuText: “That is none of your business.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You are right. It is hard for her...."
entries.dialogueText: “You are right. It is hard for her.”
entries.menuText: “You are right. It is hard for her.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It is hard for both of us.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It is hard for both of us.”
entries.menuText: “It is hard for both of us.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“My daughter looks up to the First..."
entries.dialogueText: “My daughter looks up to the First Lady for inspiration. Not only my daughter, sir."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“All this attention, adjusting to t..."
entries.dialogueText: “All this attention, adjusting to this new high-profile life, and a husband that has great responsibility...”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Very good. I must tend to my docum..."
entries.dialogueText: “Very good. I must tend to my documents for a bit.”
entries.menuText: “Very good. I must tend to my documents for a bit.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Of course, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Of course, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Hotel West was supposedly the b..."
entries.dialogueText: The Hotel West was supposedly the best hotel in Narbel. The large 25-story main building was undoubtedly one of the taller and more expensive buildings in the city. It towered over the nearby slums and had been a target for protests when it was first built.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A crowd was gathered in front of th..."
entries.dialogueText: A crowd was gathered in front of the hotel with the welcoming committee at its centre. As we approached the red carpeted entrance I could see the Mayor of Narbel and his top aides.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge got out of the car and opened..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge got out of the car and opened the door. He bowed his head respectfully and gestured towards the entrance.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Thank you sir. Likewise.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you sir. Likewise.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I gathered my documents, my bag and..."
entries.dialogueText: I gathered my documents, my bag and I left the car.
entries.menuText: Exit the vehicle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As soon as I left the vehicle, the..."
entries.dialogueText: As soon as I left the vehicle, the fresh air of Narbel filled my lungs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Almost immediately, everyone presen..."
entries.dialogueText: Almost immediately, everyone present in the crowd flocked over to me with an excessive display of courtesy, smiles and handshakes while I donned the mask of a politician.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A mask that I was very used to."
entries.dialogueText: A mask that I was very used to.
